_how: The fixed list every still passes BEFORE the person sees it (klaudia_photo.py review). Free checks first (size, one face, face size for sung shots), then, with the key, a vision model answers this list. A still that fails: make it once more (inside the same yes); if it fails again, show it with the reason and let the person choose.
checks: exactly one woman unless the shot asks for more people
her face is the same woman as the reference sheet (same face shape, eyes, nose, lips)
straight heavy black fringe and very long straight black hair with ONE orange streak
orange lips and black winged eyeliner
a grown woman (never looks under age)
no letters, words, numbers or logos anywhere in the picture
the framing asked for (close-up, medium, wide)
hands with five fingers, nothing melted or doubled
no star hair clip, no headset microphone
sing_checks: she faces the camera with her whole mouth visible (no hand, hair or object in front of it)
lips closed or nearly closed, a calm neutral face
her face is big enough: close-up or medium close-up
